newsitem.title: USA: Sallie Mae pricing floating rate notes Mon.
newsitem.headline: Sallie Mae pricing floating rate notes Mon.

text.p: The Student Loan Marketing Association said Friday it will price $400 million of short-term floating rate notes on Monday, April 7.
When-issued trading is expected to begin at 0820 hrs EDT (1220 GMT) the following day, it said.
The notes are for settlement April 10. Maturity date is Oct 16, 1997. Cusip number is 86387TFB9.
Sallie Mae said the notes will be priced at a spread to the bond equivalent rate of the 91-day Treasury bill, with the interest rate reset the day after each weekly T-bill auction.
